findings.name: platform_and_origin_labels
findings.evidence: Each run.os must equal its platform label. Windows requires the replay contract marker plus true replay flags in run and comparison. Linux requires no marker, false flags and a recorded environment label containing WSL. Teacher forcing is rejected.

findings.name: executed_script_identity_window
findings.evidence: The script digest is captured at entry before parsing or reading comparison inputs, seeded in bound, and rehashed in the final closure.

findings.name: both_gpu_record_paths
findings.evidence: Both Windows- and Linux-comparison GPU record paths are parsed/hashed against their identical recorded digests and retained in final closure, even when directories differ.

other_reviewed_guards: Source comparisons must be complete, provenance-passing and exact, with no missing/failed pages.
Manifest IDs/order and complete selected page objects agree with the parent; source counts must be200 and24.
Both CPU actual records are compared across IDs/text/stops/dimensions/counts/backend/layout; token IDs/text/stops and prefix lengths are checked directly against GPU records.
Input JSON is parsed from the same bytes that are hashed; source report/run/record files are rehashed at closure; existing output is refused.
Historical startup gaps, Windows text replay, WSL execution and absent historical GPU dimensions remain explicit.
limits: No full join invocation, corpus scan, synthetic comparison fixture or partial-report substitution was performed.
The review does not create completed Windows200 evidence. Actual join must wait for its completed strict comparison.
Existing comparison reports supply historical provenance qualifications; this join is saved-output agreement, not new inference, tensor parity, OCR accuracy or performance qualification.
